summary: OpenAI published a patch release (v0.0.6) for its gpt-oss open-weight model tooling, including Metal backend optimizations, a Responses API token limit increase, and minor dependency and tool-integration fixes.

practices.reason: The Responses API output token cap was raised, which engineering teams integrating with it should be aware of but requires no immediate migration work.
practices.quote: Increase max output tokens in Reponses API to 131K by @Maratyszcza in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/165

practices.reason: Metal-specific changes like memory-locking model weights and KV-cache fixes are concrete serving techniques but tied to OpenAI's own Metal implementation rather than a generalizable, benchmarked gain.
practices.quote: Metal: mlock model weights in memory by @Maratyszcza in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/170
